clips.hook: Clix jumped out of his own plane
clips.title: Clix bailed out of his own plane mid-mission in GTA 6
clips.caption: Zero hesitation, zero plan 😭
clips.voice_intro: Clix had exactly one job on this mission: keep the plane in the air.
clips.voice_outro: Instead he bailed at full speed and let the plane fly itself. No plan, no hesitation, and somehow it still worked out.
